en.title: Pronouncing Nu Mai in Romanian
en.summary: Learn how to say nu mai quickly by keeping the word mai light and unstressed.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs:
You often hear the phrase (nu mai) /nu maj/.
It means no more.
Stress is the strength you give to one syllable so that it sounds louder.
A syllable is one beat of a word.
The first word takes the stress.
The second word has an unstressed syllable.
An unstressed syllable is a syllable that you say with less strength.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs:
Use your lips and voice.
A short sound is a sound that you say very quickly.
Say the first part with strong voice.
Move your tongue smoothly to the next part.
Keep the second part light and short.
Do not pause between the two parts.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs:
You write (nu mai) /nu maj/ as two separate words.
A letter is a written sign of the alphabet.
Every letter shows a sound here.
No mark sits between the two words.
You read them together as one flow.
The second word loses its heavy beat in fast speech.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs:
Do not say each word with equal force.
Many learners make the second word too long.
A long sound is a sound that you hold for more time.
You must not pause in the middle.
Always give more power to the first word.
Make (nu mai) /nu maj/ sound like one quick unit.
